programs.title: American Loggers
programs.desc:
In this series, we meet the Pelletier family - nine brothers who have to deal with the harsh nature, equipment failures and everyday squabbles so that their company, Pelletier Inc., can function smoothly.This company is the embodiment of the American dream.50 years ago, Gerald Pelletier founded it on his own, with one truck and $100.Currently, his sons run a large corporation that employs dozens of workers and uses hundreds of machines to cut down thousands of hectares of forest.
The hurricane that has been raging all week makes it virtually impossible for lumberjacks to work.The Pelletiers also have to deal with an overloaded trailer that loses its load and blocks the transport of trunks on the route from Telos to Canada.Increasing downpours and mudflows force the family to stop working in the forest for the whole day.This means another financial loss for the company.As the weather improves, Wayne Pelletier tries to make up for lost time by attaching two trailers to his truck, but the roads are covered with mud and silt and prove treacherous.In the forest, Larry Pelettier tries his best to cut down a tree.The weather breaks and the Pelletiers have to come to terms with the lowest weekly production in the history of the company.

programs.title: American Loggers
programs.desc:
In this series, we meet the Pelletier family - nine brothers who have to deal with the harsh nature, equipment failures and everyday squabbles so that their company, Pelletier Inc., can function smoothly.This company is the embodiment of the American dream.50 years ago, Gerald Pelletier founded it on his own, with one truck and $100.Currently, his sons run a large corporation that employs dozens of workers and uses hundreds of machines to cut down thousands of hectares of forest.
By late fall, the ground in Maine should be frozen and conditions for working in the forest should be optimal.However, this year, due to long-lasting rains, the humidity is still very high, so the work was suspended by the forester.The Pelletiers are impatient and as soon as the ban is lifted, they take action with increased energy.Seasoned veteran Randy Burgoin hits the Golden Trail.Unfortunately, he causes a serious accident and he has to go to the hospital as soon as possible.Finally, the long-awaited frosts arrive and the work of lumberjacks becomes much easier and more effective.To celebrate the coming of winter, the brothers light a bonfire in the forest and throw a big party.
